thread:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy report for release v3.4.1 -> us-west (canary 5%): synthetic probe 'embed-synth-fastpath' has tripped fail-fast on 3 hosts. p95 latency ↑, error-rate ↑. Automated quickcheck summary: p95 420ms (baseline 180ms), errors 4.2% (baseline 0.3%). Docs: https://runbooks/release-smoke. @sre-oncall @maria please advise

jonah: I just pulled proxy traces from the affected canary hosts — most spikes are TCP-level retransmits + 502s from the inference-proxy, not the model container itself. grabbing full logs now.

maria: Does the runtime switch we rolled (kvcache prefill change) touch proxy path? I thought that was opt-in. If it's proxy-related maybe roll-forward isn't safe. Could we route canary -> fallback model-variant (v3.4.1-quant) while we triage? :thinking_face:

alex: Canary traffic was at 5% via deploy policy. Hosts: i-0a1b2c3d, i-0f9e8d7c, i-00aa11bb showed the fail-fast. Quick healthcheck snippet:

```
$ curl -v -sS http://i-0a1b2c3d.internal/health
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{"uptime":"2h","kv_cache_ready":true,"inflight":120}
```

alex: No OOMs reported in container logs; proxy upstream returns 502 before request reaches model.

sre-oncall: Recommend: pause rollout (hold remaining hosts), revert canary fraction to previous version for traffic routing, and run a targeted smoke sweep on the 3 affected hosts. Let's avoid org-wide rollback unless it persists >10 minutes after mitigation.

maria: Agreed. Plan: 1) Pause rollout. 2) Re-route canary 5% to v3.4.0. 3) Run targeted synthetic with header X-Debug:canary on affected hosts and capture full proxy logs. 4) If errors persist after 5m -> rollback fully.

jonah: Kicking off targeted probes now. Command I used: `./tools/synth-run --probe embed-synth-fastpath --hosts i-0a1b2c3d,i-0f9e8d7c,i-00aa11bb --repeat 50 --header \"X-Debug:canary\"`

deploy-bot: Rolling action: paused rollout at 5% (actions by alex). Rerouting canary traffic back to v3.4.0 for the 3 affected hosts at 6498765440. Quickcheck still running.

alex: Confirmed traffic shift. Keeping canary instances live for logs only (no production traffic).

maria: Results from targeted synth after 2m: 15/150 requests returned 502 concentrated on i-0a1b2c3d, same stacktrace in proxy: `upstream timeout while reading response` — looks like short-lived backend stall. Potentially a file-descriptor exhaustion on the proxy worker.

sre-oncall: If it's FD exhaustion, a graceful restart of proxy on those hosts may clear it. We can try `systemctl restart inference-proxy` on the three hosts and monitor. If restart fixes synths -> resume rollout with slower ramp. If not -> full rollback.

jonah: Restarting proxy on i-0a1b2c3d now. Will report back.

alex: Also snapshotting `netstat -anp | grep ESTAB | wc -l` and `lsof -p $(pidof inference-proxy)` before restart for post-mortem.

deploy-bot: Update: proxy restart on i-0a1b2c3d completed at 6498765480. Targeted synth re-run shows error drop: now 1/50 failed on that host.

maria: Good signal. Recommend we keep rollout paused, continue slow ramp after 15m of stable canary synths. No full rollback required at this time. I'll open a follow-up ticket for proxy FD limits and add a preflight check to synth-run that checks FD usage.

sre-oncall: +1. If any host shows >2% error over a 5m sliding window we revert canary routing immediately. Logging this decision. :white_check_mark: 

jonah: copying logs to /artifacts/release-v3.4.1/canary-proxy-logs-6498765432.tar.gz

alex: adding small note to release notes: "v3.4.1: rolled back canary routing, post-deploy probe flagged proxy upstream timeouts; mitigated by targeted proxy restarts; rollout paused for extended observation."

deploy-bot: Thread archived for now; will reopen if quickcheck degrades. If anyone needs to escalate, tag @sre-oncall.
